channel.title: Tuesday Bible: Verses for Real Moments
channel.copyright: © 2026 Honest Little Apps. Scripture: World English Bible (public domain).
channel.description:
Most people know what the Bible says. Few know what to do with it on a Tuesday. Each short episode takes one real moment, like the text you shouldn't send or the 3 a.m. worry, reads one verse from the World English Bible (public domain), and offers one small step for today.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Lampstep: Bible for Real Life, a one-minute daily Bible app built around real moments. Lampstep: Bible for Real Life on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
